stratagems.name: Teleport Assault
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally from all enemy models.

stratagems.name: Warp Shaping
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on an unmodified Wound roll of 6, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: Banishment
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of a DAEMON unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack against a DAEMON unit, add 1 to the Wound roll and the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack is improved by 1.

stratagems.name: Psybolt Ammunition
stratagems.target: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of bolt weapons used by models in your unit by 2.
